title: Mailjet Review (2026)
intro: Mailjet is evaluated here as email marketing software — Mailjet (Sinch Mailjet) is an email platform covering marketing campaigns and transactional/API sending with a collaborative editor. Pricing is primarily send-volume based: Free $0 (6,000 emails/mo, 200/day), Starter from $9/mo, Essential from $17/mo, Premium from $27/mo at researched volume bands; Custom enterprise. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Mailjet when EU-friendly marketing + transactional email with send-volume pricing is the priority.
verdict: Choose Mailjet when EU-friendly marketing + transactional email with send-volume pricing is the priority. Compare Brevo for broader multi-channel SMB value, Customer.io for product-led event messaging, GetResponse for all-in-one marketing automation, and Mailchimp for brand-familiar freemium. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
